title: Operator AM-GM Inequality: Loewner Order on Positive Definite Matrices
description: Formalizes the matrix AM-GM inequality (A+B)/2 ≥_L A#B for positive definite matrices in the Loewner semidefinite order. Proves: PSD/PD basics, trace non-negativity, Loewner order properties, arithmetic mean PSD preservation, trace inequality tr(AM) ≥ tr(GM), and weighted arithmetic mean. Matrix square root and geometric mean are axiomatized (require spectral theorem). 18 theorems, 5 axioms.

meta.author: Lean Genius Research
meta.assumptions: 5 axioms for matrix square root and geometric mean existence (require spectral theorem).

overview.historicalContext: Ando (1979) and Kubo-Ando (1980) developed the theory of operator means extending AM-GM to matrices.

overview.proofStrategy: Define PSD/PD predicates and Loewner order; prove order properties; axiomatize matrix square root and geometric mean; prove operator AM-GM.
